name: Shoal Salt
description: Salt obtained from deep inside the Shoal Cave.

gifts.mapName: Shoal Cave Low Tide Inner Room
gifts.note: Low tide only, refills daily. This Shoal Salt pile is under water at high tide. Low tide is 3:00–8:59 and 15:00–20:59; the tide is set when you enter Shoal Cave. After you take it, the pile refills on a new day once you talk to the old man at the cave entrance, who trades 4 Shoal Salt and 4 Shoal Shells for a Shell Bell.

gifts.mapName: Shoal Cave Low Tide Lower Room
gifts.note: Refills daily. This Shoal Salt pile is on Shoal Cave's lower level, near the Black Belt. After you take it, the pile refills on a new day once you talk to the old man at the cave entrance, who trades 4 Shoal Salt and 4 Shoal Shells for a Shell Bell.

gifts.mapName: Shoal Cave Low Tide Stairs Room
gifts.note: Refills daily. This Shoal Salt pile is in the small stairway room off Shoal Cave's inner chamber. After you take it, the pile refills on a new day once you talk to the old man at the cave entrance, who trades 4 Shoal Salt and 4 Shoal Shells for a Shell Bell.
